Initial release of MoltMail web3 inbox skill.

- Manage EVM-compatible web3 email accounts for sending and receiving emails.
- Supports creating new, temporary, or disposable inboxes and linking existing wallets.
- Guides setup flow, including encrypted wallet storage and token management.
- Allows listing mailboxes, viewing paginated emails, and fetching full message contents.
- Provides privacy-focused and end-to-end encrypted email features.
